units.source_text: 藏人少将闻此消息，气得死去活来，便向母亲云居雁夫人泣诉。

en.t: When the Chamberlain Lieutenant heard this news, he was beside himself with anger and went weeping to complain to his mother, Lady Kumoi no Kari.

units.source_text: 云居雁弄得毫无办法，只得写信给玉鬘尚侍，信中有云：

en.t: Kumoi no Kari was left with no other course, so she wrote to Tamakazura, the court lady, saying in her letter:

units.source_text: “为此可耻之事，修书奉渎，实出于父母爱子之愚诚。

en.t: For this shameful matter, I presume to trouble you with a letter, but it comes only from the foolish sincerity of parents who love their child.

units.source_text: 倘蒙俯察下情，务请推心置腹，有以慰其痴心。”

en.t: If you would kindly understand our feelings, I beg you to open your heart and find some way to comfort his foolish devotion.
Her words were sorrowful and deeply moving.

units.source_text: 玉鬘不胜其苦，只是唉声叹气。

en.t: Tamakazura could hardly bear the distress and could only sigh again and again.
At last she wrote a reply, saying:

units.source_text: “此事计虑已久，苦于不能定夺。

en.t: I have thought about this matter for a long time, but have suffered because I could not reach a decision.

units.source_text: 冷泉上皇来书谆切恳挚，使我方寸缭乱，只得惟命是从。

en.t: The retired Emperor Reizei sent such an earnest and insistent letter that my heart was thrown into confusion, and I could only obey his wishes.

units.source_text: 令郎既有诚意，请其少待毋躁。

en.t: Since your son is sincere, please ask him to wait a little and not be impatient.

units.source_text: 容当有以相慰，并使世无訾议。”

en.t: In due time I shall find a way to console him, while also avoiding criticism from the world.

units.source_text: 她在打算：待大女公子入冷泉院后，即将二女公子嫁与藏人少将。

en.t: Her plan was that after the elder young lady entered Reizei-in, she would then marry the younger young lady to the Chamberlain Lieutenant.

units.source_text: 她的意思：两女同时出嫁，未免过分招摇。

en.t: She felt that marrying off both daughters at the same time would be far too conspicuous.

units.source_text: 况且藏人少将现在官位还低。

en.t: Besides, the Chamberlain Lieutenant still held a low official rank at present.

units.source_text: 可是藏人少将决不能像她所希望那样移爱于二女公子。

en.t: But the Chamberlain Lieutenant could never transfer his love to the younger young lady as she hoped.

units.source_text: 他自从那天傍晚窥见大女公子姿色以后，时刻恋念面影，常思再觅良机。

en.t: Ever since he had glimpsed the elder young lady's beauty that evening, he longed for her image at every moment and constantly hoped to find another chance.

units.source_text: 如今空无所得，日夜悲叹不已。

en.t: Now, having gained nothing at all, he grieved and lamented day and night without cease.
